source.section: IX. Dances and Tempi, 'Lifts and Dangerous Movements' (1)-(3)(g) (printed p39)
source.quote_free_summary: Couples who lift where lifts are not allowed may be disqualified under the 'Implementation of Disqualification' rule. Adjudicators mark 'D' for an infringement and tell the Chairman, who informs the couple and all adjudicators before the next round. A repeat reported by more than one adjudicator means the marks for that dance are deleted; in the final the couple is placed last in that dance if more than one adjudicator marks 'D'; all such disqualifications are noted on the scrutineers' sheet; if a competitor keeps ignoring the Chairman, the Chairman may disqualify them from the event.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must implement the 'D' mark, Chairman notification, mark deletion, last-place final placement and discretionary event disqualification as source-defined steps. None exists now and none is authorized by OD-20.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile scoring and Chairman workflow. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Note: the final-round outcome is 'placed last', which differs from DanceFlow no-show semantics (not placed) and from organizer exclusion (not ranked); the three must stay distinct.
